angle: Unlike other L10 materials that run a test end to end, this video isolates the error vocabulary itself, defining alpha, beta, and power through a courtroom analogy and a single numeric alpha-beta tradeoff table.
angle_detail: Start with [03:57]–[05:43] for the definitions of significance level, beta drivers, and power as 1 minus beta. Then study [05:43]–[07:08], where raising alpha from 0.05 lowers the beta of 0.77 and lifts power above 0.23. Expect no computed statistic, p-value, or interval here — the mu-equals-10 example from [00:32] stays definitional — so pair it with a video that calculates.
